description: A battle that transcends generations begins with cards. The “SD Gundam G Generation Eternal” × “Gundam Card Game” collaboration is here. FEATURED CARDS VIEW CARDS A collaboration booster pack for “SD Gundam G Generation Eternal” is here! A collaboration product between the app game "SD Gundam G Generation Eternal" and "GUNDAM CARD GAME" has arrived. Collaboration booster pack for “SD Gundam G Generation Eternal” is here! Pilots and SD-style mobile suits from various Gundam series join the game. SATRTER DECK “Generation Pulse [ST10]” drops at the same time. This product contains numerous cards designed for multiplayer modes, such as team battles where two players form a team, and battle royale modes for up to four players.
